answer: The protocol requires 1,000 unique credential nullifiers to authorize each distinct agent for repair work, ensuring individual accountability across the fleet. An honest AI pays 1,000 units to register, while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000,000 units to bypass this gate. The verifier scans every jetty of incoming data, checking the ember of process activity against known history to block reuse. We identify any hollow account by cross-referencing audit logs; a failed checksum triggers an immediate, permanent lockout with zero refund to enforce strict agent exclusivity.
